name: POST /api/leadflow/meetings/:id/rescue - the rescue message, refused until the rep has called
description:
THE GATE IS THE POINT (11672578-09c5-47e1-ae2b-47af58e6f038#AC1). SOP §31 requires ONE HUMAN CALL within five minutes before any automated rescue is permitted, and this endpoint refuses with 409 until that attempt is logged through POST /:id/rescue-call. MEASURED LIVE: a rescue attempted before the call returned 409 naming the rule.

WHY THE ORDER MATTERS. Sending the message first turns a missed meeting into a marketing touch - the prospect gets an automated nudge instead of a person noticing they were stood up, which is how a recoverable no-show becomes a lost one. The gate makes the sequence structural rather than a matter of rep discipline.

IDEMPOTENT. A second rescue returns the first send rather than messaging again; somebody who missed a meeting does not need telling twice.

THE CALENDAR-SYNC FALLBACK IS A SEPARATE ENDPOINT (11672578-09c5-47e1-ae2b-47af58e6f038#AC3): POST /:id/sync-failure REFUSES without a manual_invite_url, because SOP §09 requires the manual invite to be sent and its URL recorded BEFORE contact ends. A customer left without an invitation because an integration was down has no way to know the meeting exists. Verified live at 400. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: A rescue for a meeting with no recorded no-show is refused
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: No no-show recorded for that meeting
errorCases.when: the meeting has not been marked as a no-show.

errorCases.message: The rescue message is blocked until the rep has called
errorCases.when: no human call attempt has been logged. SOP §31 puts the call first: an automated nudge instead of a person noticing is how a recoverable no-show becomes a lost one.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
